component.name: Proton Drive Sync
component.summary: Two-way file sync for Proton Drive

description.p: A desktop client for the Proton Drive sync engine: a systemd user daemon that keeps a local folder and a Proton Drive folder in sync, and a graphical interface for its status, activity, conflicts, dry-run review, and settings.

ul.li: Live status, activity history, and per-pass plan summaries
Non-destructive conflict resolution with a side-by-side compare
Dry-run plan review with a typed confirmation before destructive changes
A system-tray indicator and a settings editor for the sync configuration

description.p: Initial desktop UI: overview, activity, conflicts, plan preview, history, settings, delete-approval, onboarding, and a system tray.
